CHECK BURST K3p-chk-walk-01 — the Keeper WALK-E cycle against the COMMITTED walk band (R-29/R-a, row plate13_lateral_ann): gait intent gates, oracle curves, loop closure. task_id "K3p-chk-walk-01".

Inputs (read-only): the sole-aligned frames /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-1/artifacts/K3p-reg-walk-01/frames/walk/E/walk_E_00.png … walk_E_11.png (512×512 RGBA); the committed band file /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/oracle/bands_walk.json (row 'plate13_lateral_ann' — committed; its 'phase_table' is the expected 12-frame phase schedule); the dope sheet /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-1/oracle/dope_walk_12.json. Frozen tools (read-only; run, never modify or create code; read each docstring): gates/gait_intent.py evaluate(frames_dir, bands_walk_row, phase_table) — pass a COPY of the committed row with 'arm_roles' = {"near": "free_arm", "far": "weapon_arm"} (direction E: her left/camera side is the free arm; her right/far side carries the staff) and phase_table = the 12 candidate phases from the dope sheet in frame order; report W1 floor/ceiling, W2 phase match with the observed extrema, W3a, W3c, W4, W5 per arm vs the role limits, W6 opposed frames — each with its passed flag (committed → booleans); oracle/walk_bands.py CLI: `python3 -m oracle.walk_bands --ours <frames dir> --fps 12 --label walk_E_K3p --k_vert 1.25 --out out/walk_E_K3p_measure.json --plot_dir out/plots` (WRITE ONLY UNDER out/ — the frozen band file must not be touched); gates/g6_seam.py (G6 literal, G6b, and g6c: seam 11→0 vs its half-cycle homologue 5→6 — the L5 instrument); gates/drift48.py (G11 every adjacent pair + the seam); gates/g1_height.py (each frame vs the rest frame /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-1/artifacts/K3p-reg-walk-01/frames/rest/E/rest_E.png); gates/silhouette64.py (distance of every frame to the rest frame); per-frame sole lines + the ground-line spread; the planted-foot x per frame (from the landmarks the instrument emits) so a moonwalk or a repeated lead is visible as a number.
Produce out/checks.json = SPEC § 1 result envelopes (gait_intent full payload; G6/G6b/G6c; G11 per pair; G1; silhouette distances; sole/ground spread; planted-foot table), out/plots/ (curves + mask check), out/checks_readme.txt with the exact commands.
No image_gen. No writes outside out/. No web. calls_used must be 0.
RETURN: receipt task_id "K3p-chk-walk-01"; images []; calls_used 0; files: every out/ file with sha256; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns must name anything you could not compute. Never PASS/FAIL.
